name: The Girl Who Did Not Know Who She Is
source: In a seemingly ordinary town, Keiichi, an average high school student, encounters a mysterious girl who disrupts his routine. Unlike anyone he has met, she embodies innocence but lacks understanding of the world around her.
translation: 在一个看似普通的小镇上，普通高中生庆一遇到了一个扰乱他日常生活的神秘女孩。与他见过的任何人不同，她表现出纯真，但对周围的世界缺乏了解。
